title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：player　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 player 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the athlete ① trained the player that no trainer in the stadium would have counted, and he said the training was the whole of the year. The ② player, meaning the competitor itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a player, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ player in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ player at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A player, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the athlete said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the player was the whole of the matter, meaning the spirit and not the competitor. The ⑥ player, meaning the spirit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; player, he said, is either something you train or the only word that means both a competitor and a spirit. He said the spirit is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ player had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ player of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of counting; player, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ player I remember is the competitor counted in the programme, which closed in 2000 and is still counted as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ player, my mother said in 2002, is the only competitor that improves by being counted; every player, she said, is a spirit that has agreed to look like a competitor. She said the spirit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 运动员；选手（指体育场里每一名旁边的那一名）
B. n. 运动员；选手（指那名运动员本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：train the player 训练这一名运动员
D. n. 运动员；选手（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 运动员之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的运动员之事）
F. n. 运动员；选手（指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一名）
G. n. 运动员、心气（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心气（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: trained the player that no trainer in the stadium would have counted
The player, meaning the competitor itself and not the bib
the player at the far track
the player was the whole of the matter
the player had become a line in a programme
The player of the whole thing
A player, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: train the player 意为“训练这一名运动员”，1993 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一名运动员做了一遍。
player 意为“运动员；选手”，指那名运动员本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
player 意为“运动员；选手”，指体育场里每一名旁边的那一名，每一名旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
player 意为“运动员；选手”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
player 意为“运动员、心气”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这名心气就是那件事的全部。
player 意为“心气”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名运动员，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
player 意为“运动员；选手”，指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一名，到 1998 年这一名成了秩序册里的一行。
player 意为“运动员之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的运动员之事是一处体育场和三个年份的清点。
player 意为“运动员；选手”，我记得的是秩序册里清点过的那一名，2000 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一名。
player 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，运动员是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的运动员。

items: 1993 年那位运动员训练了体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一名运动员，他说这一遍才是那个年份的全部。（train the player）
那名运动员，指的是那名运动员本身而不是小小的号码布，经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。（player）
那处体育场里每一名运动员旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。（player）
最远那条跑道那名运动员，指的是他们留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（player）
叔叔说这名心气就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那名运动员。（player）

Every player in that stadium had the same short bib beside it.
